No front door

Followers stay followers

A parent can save your strategies for a year and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Every enquiry starts from zero

Coaching, the Bootcamp and school talks all sit behind one link. A class lets parents see how you think first, so the ones who apply already trust your approach.

Content treadmill

2,563 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post and the next presentation. When you step back to rest or coach, the enquiries step back too.

The parents who love your tips but aren't ready for coaching today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The chart that stopped working"

Hook
"If the reward chart worked brilliantly for three days and then stopped, nobody did anything wrong. Here's what's going on." (to camera, bright room, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"For a lot of kids with ADHD, novelty is what makes a new system work at first. When it wears off, the system stops, and parents end up blaming themselves or their child. What helps is getting curious about what's really getting in the way, then building the routine around that." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach parents exactly how in a live 90-minute class called Curious, Not Furious. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you react"

Hook
"Before you raise your voice in the next hard moment, ask these three questions." (Allison holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: is this a won't, or a can't right now? Two: what happened just before? Three: what one change would make this easier tomorrow? The answers change the whole conversation." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go through the full approach in my live masterclass for parents, Curious, Not Furious. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"Parents ask me where to start: my free tips, the Bootcamp, or coaching. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my live class first. You'll learn how I think about the hardest parts of the day, try a few strategies that week, and know which next step fits your family."
CTA
"It's called Curious, Not Furious, it's $17, and there's a replay if bedtime gets in the way. Tap Sign up."
